{{raw-eggs}}'''Egg soda''' (Vietnamese: ''soda sữa hột gà'', Khmer: សូដាក្រឡុកពងមាន់, ''lsau da kralok pongmean'') is a sweet drink made from egg yolk and carbonated water, popular in Vietnam and Cambodia.

==Ingredients== 
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolk]]
* [[Cookbook:Carbonated Water|Carbonated water]] (as needed, about 1–2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] / 250–500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5–17 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]])
* Ice

==Procedure==
# Fill a glass with ice.
# In another glass, combine the condensed milk and egg yolk.
# Add carbonated water to the desired level, and mix until well-blended.
# Pour liquid over ice. 
# Enjoy.
